concept: S3 Cross-Region Replication: versioning and IAM role
tests: Knowing the prerequisites for automatically copying S3 objects to another Region.
expected: Cross-Region Replication with an IAM role for replication + versioning on the source and destination buckets. Existing objects — only via S3 Batch Replication. Triggers: "automatically copied", "bucket in another region", "disaster recovery".
why_not: SRR replicates within a single Region; Transfer Acceleration only speeds up client uploads via edge locations and does not copy between buckets.
